name: Acid Splash
description: You create an acidic bubble at a point you choose, which bursts in a 5-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity save, taking 1d6 Acid damage on a failure.

name: Dancing Lights
description: You create up to four torch-sized lights, which appear as floating lights hovering in the air. As a Bonus Action you can move them up to 60 feet.

name: Fire Bolt
description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage.

name: Guidance
description: You touch a willing creature. Once before the spell ends, it can roll a d4 and add the number to one ability check of its choice.

name: Light
description: You touch one Large or smaller object. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.

name: Mage Hand
description: A spectral hand appears at a point you choose. You can use an action to control the hand and manipulate objects weighing up to 10 pounds.

name: Minor Illusion
description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration.

name: Prestidigitation
description: You create a harmless sensory effect, light or snuff a small flame, clean or soil an object, or produce a trinket.

name: Ray of Frost
description: A frigid beam streaks toward a creature. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Cold damage and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet.

name: Sacred Flame
description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature you can see. It makes a Dexterity save, taking 1d8 Radiant damage on a failure. It gains no benefit from cover.

name: Shocking Grasp
description: Lightning springs from your hand. Make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage and can't take Reactions until its next turn.

name: Spare the Dying
description: Choose a creature with 0 hit points within range that isn't dead. It becomes Stable.

name: Thaumaturgy
description: You manifest a minor wonder within range: your voice booms, flames flicker, tremors shake the ground, or a door flies open.

name: Vicious Mockery
description: You unleash a string of insults at a creature. It makes a Wisdom save, taking 1d6 Psychic damage and having Disadvantage on its next attack on a failure.

name: Bless
description: You bless up to three creatures. Whenever one makes an attack roll or saving throw before the spell ends, it rolls a d4 and adds the number to the total.

name: Burning Hands
description: A thin sheet of flames shoots from you. Each creature in the Cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Charm Person
description: One creature you can see makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or you or your allies harm it.

name: Cure Wounds
description: A creature you touch regains hit points equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Detect Magic
description: You sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet. You can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible magical creature or object.

name: Disguise Self
description: You make yourself look different until the spell ends. The changes wrought are illusory and don't hold up to physical inspection.

name: Faerie Fire
description: Objects in a 20-foot Cube are outlined in light. Creatures there make a Dexterity save or are outlined too; attack rolls against them have Advantage.

name: Feather Fall
description: Choose up to five falling creatures. Their rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round, and they take no damage from the fall.

name: Guiding Bolt
description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature. Make a ranged spell attack for 4d6 Radiant damage; the next attack roll against the target has Advantage.

name: Healing Word
description: A creature you can see regains hit points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Mage Armor
description: You touch a willing creature that isn't wearing armour. Its base Armour Class becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier.

name: Magic Missile
description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each strikes a creature of your choice for 1d4+1 Force damage, and they hit unerringly.

name: Shield
description: An invisible barrier of magical force protects you. You gain a +5 bonus to Armour Class, including against the triggering attack, and take no damage from Magic Missile.

name: Sleep
description: Each creature in a 5-foot-radius Sphere makes a Wisdom save or gains the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn.

name: Thunderwave
description: Each creature in the Cube makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 Thunder damage and being pushed 10 feet on a failure.

name: Aid
description: Choose up to three creatures. Each one's hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for the duration.

name: Darkness
description: Magical Darkness spreads from a point you choose to fill a 15-foot-radius Sphere. Darkvision can't see through it.

name: Hold Person
description: Choose a Humanoid you can see. It makes a Wisdom save or has the Paralyzed condition, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Invisibility
description: A creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends or it makes an attack or casts a spell.

name: Misty Step
description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

name: Scorching Ray
description: You hurl three fiery rays. Make a ranged spell attack for each; a hit deals 2d6 Fire damage.

name: Spiritual Weapon
description: You create a floating spectral weapon. As a Bonus Action you can move it and make a melee spell attack for 1d8 Force damage plus your spellcasting modifier.

name: Web
description: You fill a 20-foot Cube with thick webs, which is Difficult Terrain. A creature entering it makes a Dexterity save or has the Restrained condition.

name: Counterspell
description: You attempt to interrupt a creature casting a spell. It makes a Constitution save, and on a failure the spell fails and has no effect.

name: Dispel Magic
description: Choose a creature, object, or magical effect. Any spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends; for higher levels, make an ability check against DC 10 plus the spell's level.

name: Fireball
description: A bright streak flashes to a point you choose and blossoms into a fiery explosion in a 20-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature there makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Fly
description: A willing creature you touch gains a Fly Speed of 60 feet for the duration.

name: Haste
description: A willing creature's Speed doubles, it gains +2 Armour Class and Advantage on Dexterity saves, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: A stroke of lightning blasts out from you in a Line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature there makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 Lightning damage on a failure.

name: Revivify
description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. It returns to life with 1 hit point.

name: Dimension Door
description: You teleport to a spot you can see or describe, and can bring one willing creature of your size or smaller with you.

name: Greater Invisibility
description: A creature you touch has the Invisible condition for the duration, even if it attacks or casts spells.

name: Polymorph
description: A creature you can see makes a Wisdom save or is transformed into a Beast whose Challenge Rating is no higher than its own.

name: Wall of Fire
description: You create a wall of fire on a solid surface. Each creature in the wall's area makes a Dexterity save, taking 5d8 Fire damage on a failure.

name: Cone of Cold
description: A blast of cold air erupts from your hands. Each creature in the Cone makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 Cold damage on a failure.

name: Mass Cure Wounds
description: Each of up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius Sphere regains hit points equal to 5d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Raise Dead
description: You return a dead creature to life with 1 hit point, provided it has been dead no longer than 10 days.

name: Chain Lightning
description: A lightning bolt leaps to a target, then arcs to up to three more. Each makes a Dexterity save, taking 10d8 Lightning damage on a failure.

name: True Seeing
description: A creature you touch gains Truesight out to 120 feet, seeing in Darkness, detecting Invisible creatures, and perceiving through illusions.

name: Finger of Death
description: You send negative energy at a creature. It makes a Constitution save, taking 7d8+30 Necrotic damage on a failure.

name: Teleport
description: You teleport yourself and up to eight willing creatures to a destination you specify, with accuracy depending on your familiarity with it.

name: Power Word Stun
description: Choose a creature you can see. If it has 150 hit points or fewer, it has the Stunned condition; otherwise it has the Incapacitated condition until the end of your next turn.

name: Meteor Swarm
description: Blazing orbs plummet to the ground at four points you choose. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius Sphere at each point makes a Dexterity save, taking 20d6 Fire and 20d6 Bludgeoning damage on a failure.

name: Wish
description: You can duplicate any spell of level 8 or lower, or alter reality in a way the DM adjudicates, at the risk of never being able to cast Wish again.
